agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
January 22, 2008
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Deacon Loi Hoang, St. Francis of Assisi Catholic Church
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS - No presentations are scheduled on this agenda.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Ordinances on Agenda (CC)
C3.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C4.
Treasurer's Cash Report for Month Ending November 30, 2007 (CC)
C5.
Second Reading of Ordinances (CC/BSD)
1.
City Council Ordinance No. 2008-4, entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Establishing Rates for Sewer Service Charges for the Vista Sewer System";
2.
City Council Ordinance No. 2008-5, entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Changing the Zoning from Commercial (C-1) to Estate Residential (E-1) on a Portion of the Site and from Agricultural (A-1) to E-1 on a Portion of the Site at 2375 Vista Grande Drive";
3.
City Council Ordinance No. 2008-6, entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending the Vista Business Park Specific Plan to Incorporate New Parking Standards for Medical Office Uses and Change the Land Use Designation from Use Area "B" to Use Area "J" on 4.52 Acres at 2643 S. Melrose Drive";
4.
City Council Ordinance No. 2008-7, entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Section 14.01.060D of the Vista Municipal Code Regarding Funding of Lifeline Allowance";
5.
Buena Sanitation District Ordinance No. 2008-1, entitled "An Ordinance of the Buena Sanitation District Establishing Rates for Sewer Service Charges for the Buena Sewer System"; and
6.
Buena Sanitation District Ordinance No. 2008-2, entitled "An Ordinance of the Buena Sanitation District Amending Section 1.060D of the Buena Sanitation District Code Regarding Funding of Lifeline Allowance."
C6.
Sewer Service Charge Lifeline Rebate Program (CC/BSD)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- ; and
2.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2008- .
C7.
Fee Waiver for Vista Community Clinic (CC)
C8.
First Amendment to the Lighting Equipment Rental Agreement (CC)
C9.
Foothill Drive Project Final Change Order and Notice of Completion (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving Change Order No. 2 for the Foothill Drive Overlay and Improvement Project construction contract with Daley Corporation, in the amount of $59,586.42, and authorizing the Mayor to execute the change order; and
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , accepting the work on the Foothill Drive Overlay and Improvement Project as complete, approving the Notice of Completion, and directing the City Clerk to file the Notice of Completion with the County of San Diego Recorder's Office.
C10.
Ambulance Billing Award of Contract (CC)
C11.
Investment of City Funds Policy (CC/CDC)
1.
Approve revisions to City Council Policy No. 700-07, Investment of City Funds; and
2.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2008- , authorizing investment monies in the Local Agency Investment Fund.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM CONSENT CALENDAR FOR DISCUSSION
PUBLIC HEARINGS - WILL BEGIN AT OR AFTER 6:00 P.M.
PH1.
Park and Recreational Dedications, City of Vista, Applicant (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony; and
2.
Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2008- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Chapter 17.32 of the Vista Development Code Relating to Park and Recreational Dedications."
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
